test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the discount of 18% in the price of rice enables a housewife to buy 5 kg more for ₹1876, then the reduced price (in ₹) of rice per kg (correct to nearest ₹) is:
solution:
**Given;**

Reduction of 18% in price.

Housewife to buy 5 kg more for Rs. 1876.

**Calculation:**

Let the initial price of rice be Rs. x per kg.

Reduce the price of rice = x × 82over100 = 41xover50 

Now, according to the question,

⇒ 1876over{41xover50} - 1876over x = 5

⇒ 93,800over41x - 1876over x = 5

⇒ (93,800-76916)over41x = 5

⇒ x = 16,884over(41×5) = Rs. 82.36 per kg

Reduce the price of rice = 41xover50 = 41over50 × 82.36 = Rs. 67.5 per kg

**∴ Reduce the price of rice is Rs. 68 per kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**If the discount of d% on the price of rice enables a housewife to buy y kg more for Rs. x. 

Reduce the price of rice = xover y × d%

⇒ 1876over5 × 18% 

⇒ 1876over5 × 18over100 = Rs. 67.5 per kg

∴ Reduce the price of rice is Rs. 68 per kg.
